text:
maya: quick alert 9:33am9  ran a small ranking smoke on the new Mistral int4 artifact and saw a surprising swap in nearest neighbors vs our llama fp16 baseline. looks like a directional flip in a subset of embedding dims.

ade: numbers to ground it?

maya: summary from the quick smoke:
- baseline: llama-fp16 mean cosine (sample) = 0.84
- mistral-int4 (converted) mean cosine = 0.50
- rerank nDCG@10 delta = -0.11 absolute
- failing example: query "renewable energy incentives" top1 -> unrelated doc

seb: that pattern (half dims anticorrelated) usually means a sign or handedness inversion in the projection matrix, not typical quantization noise. could be SVD/sign-loss while folding proj layers.

li: conversion steps used:
```
# pipeline
python export.py --model mistral-v1 --out mistral.onnx --include-proj
onnx2zdr --input mistral.onnx --out mistral.zdr
zdr-quantize --model mistral.zdr --mode int4 --per_channel
```
artifact: mistral.onnx (exporter v3.2)

deploy-bot: export job completed (mistral.onnx) sha=cd34ef

nate: two quick hypotheses: 1) projection folding did U*Sigma*V^T absorption but normalized signs on U or V, 2) per-channel scale calc during quantization introduced asymmetric clipping flipping sign interpretation. both can invert subspaces.

seb: can we run a lightweight diagnostic: compute sign agreement per-dim between llama and mistral-converted embeddings on a fixed token set, and SVD the cross-covariance to detect sign flips?

li: ran a mini-probe (5k tokens sample). snippet/outputs below:
```
E_ll = embed_llama(tokens)
E_m4 = embed_mistral_int4(tokens)
sign_agree = np.mean(np.sign(E_ll) == np.sign(E_m4), axis=0)
print(sign_agree[:12])
# -> [0.02, 0.99, 0.98, 0.03, 0.97, 0.96, 0.04, 0.95, 0.96, 0.05, 0.97, 0.98]
```
looks like dims 0,3,6,9 are inverted.

seb: consistent with a deterministic sign normalization step. if the converter enforced a positive diagonal R during SVD and then absorbed R differently across channels, signs can flip relative to the baseline implementation.

li: quick manual fix: flip those dims post-embedding and re-run rerank:
```
E_fix = E_m4.copy(); E_fix[:, [0,3,6,9]] *= -1
# rerun eval -> mean cosine 0.83, nDCG@10 delta -0.01
```
so flipping recovers quality.

ade: good proof-of-concept. but needs a proper upstream patch. li: can you trace which function in the export chain touched the proj? suspect fold_proj.py in exporter v3.2.

li: confirmed. fold_proj.py calls np.linalg.svd and then applies a diag-sign-normalize(U) step to make diag positive (old heuristic). when later absorbing into token embedding vs output proj we lost the sign metadata because downstream code assumed symmetric clamping in quantization. reproducer attached locally.

nate: action items: 1) remove/guard the diag-sign-normalize heuristic and instead persist sign_d vector alongside folded weights; 2) change quantizer to compute per-channel zero-point/scale robustly and assert sign parity with float baseline; 3) add a deterministic regression that compares embeddings on a seeded token list and fails CI if mean cosine < 0.8 of baseline.

seb: also audit Gemma and Qwen conversion codepaths; similar SVD heuristics may exist there. if so, add a quick grep and small audit task.

maya: i'm adding this as a blocker for the mistral int4 rollout and updating the onboarding checklist. li, please open a PR that:
- reverts sign-normalize or makes it opt-in
- persists sign diag when folding and ensures absorption keeps orientation
- adds a unit test (small token set) and a rerank smoke test in conversion CI

li: will do. PR will include a tiny conversion artifact and the repro script. i'll add a flag `--preserve-orthant` default true to keep backwards compatibility.

deploy-bot: converter PR pipeline queued (#1319)  tests running.

nate: once merged, run the full 50k-query rerank sweep and sanity-check embeddings across headgroups. if any headwise-only flips remain, we may need headwise sign metadata.

ade: also schedule a quick sync with onboard team next Tues to scan other exporters.

seb: note for the runbook: symptoms = large pairwise cosine drop but stable per-dim variance; probe = sign_agreement vector and SVD of cross-cov. root cause = SVD sign heuristic + per-channel quant scale mismatch. remedy = preserve sign diag and robust per-channel scale.

maya: thanks all  nice fast triage. li please post PR link + minimal repro gist when ready.

li: will post later today.
